title: Derived counit normalization for a fixed sectionwise scalar model
statement: For every scheme T, fixed model m : SectionModel a T, and ordinary comparison o, there exist a derived comparison and its universal counit equation.

source.place: Fixed sectionwise scalar comparison construction, split into ordinary and derived normalization.

proof.text: Regard the universal homotopy-category counit scalarCounit as a right Kan extension. Precomposition by the homotopy quotient preserves universality because precomposition is fully faithful on natural transformations. Postcompose by the derived section equivalence and transport the ordinary functor through the given ordinary isomorphism, obtaining a universal cochain counit for D a T followed by the target derived section functor. All these transports are equivalences of categories of right extensions.

Use the universal field of the fixed SectionModel. Precompose its cochain counit by the termwise section equivalence and transport the localization functor through sectionLocalizationComparison. This makes the source derived section functor followed by model.T a second right Kan extension of precisely the same cochain functor along DerivedCategory.Q.

Apply Mathlib Functor.rightKanExtensionUnique to these two universal pairs. Its counit factorization at a complex P is the required equation: compute is scalarCounit on the homotopy image of P, the localization factors are the prescribed sectionLocalizationComparison, and the ordinary transport is the two specified mapHomologicalComplexCompIso components. This proves the normalization on all complexes without a K-flat hypothesis.

lean.statement:
theorem scalar_section_derived_comparison_exists (T : Scheme.{u})
    (model : SectionModel a T)
    (ordinary : QuotientChange.extension a T ⋙
        (equivalence Λ' T).functor ≅
      (equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E) :
    ∃ derived : D a T ⋙ derivedFunctor Λ' T ≅
        derivedFunctor Λ T ⋙ model.T,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (Modules Λ T) ℤ,
        derived.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
            model.T.map (sectionLocalizationComparison Λ T P).hom ≫
            model.ε.app
              (((equivalence Λ T).functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) =
          (derivedFunctor Λ' T).map (compute a T P) ≫
            (sectionLocalizationComparison Λ' T
              (((QuotientChange.extension a T).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P)).hom ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso ordinary (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map
              ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
                (Iso.refl ((equivalence Λ T).functor ⋙ model.E)) (.up ℤ)).inv.app P)
